title: /connect: test connection and disconnect a provider, with buttons like the queue block

AC1.note: src/tui/connect-provider-buttons.test.ts covers [Test]/[Disconnect] on every row, drawn via the queue-dock button pattern, colour from theme; Enter/click on the label still selects the provider. /provider wizard unchanged. 14 tests pass at head 5d203ec9925f83b60cb93441e09f0f01e871f882 (== merge e04715a2).

AC2.note: testProviderConnection wraps fetchOpenAiCompatModelsDetailed with the provider's resolved key (src/commands/providers.ts); tui-shell.ts renders 'ok — N models' or modelsFailureLine(label, failure) on the row without leaving /connect. connect-provider-buttons.test.ts covers success+failure via mouse.

AC3.note: src/tui/queue-nav.ts adds ConnectNavAction + stepConnectNavAction (Label/Test/Disconnect) beside stepQueueNavIndex/clampQueueNavIndex reused verbatim; queue-nav.test.ts (5 pass) unit-tests the steppers; connect-provider-buttons.test.ts drives it with real keypresses (arrow/enter/esc).

AC4.note: connect-provider-buttons.test.ts: declining an armed Disconnect (2nd choice / Esc without confirming) asserts loadShellConfig(configDir) is byte-for-byte unchanged (e.g. apiKeys still {DEEPSEEK_API_KEY: 'sk-real'}).

AC5.note: removeApiKey (shell-config.ts), logoutProvider (oauth/login.ts), removeCustomCompatProvider (provider-config.ts) each remove exactly the named provider's entry; provider-config.test.ts (24 pass) and shell-config.test.ts (18 pass) read files back and show siblings intact.

AC6.note: classifyProviderConnection returns kind:'env-var-only' when the env var is set but not by keryx; CLI/TUI refuse to remove and name the exact variable to unset (src/commands/providers.ts:886-998); providers.disconnect.test.ts covers it with injected env + temp config dir.

AC7.note: src/harness/provider/make-provider-disconnect.test.ts (dedicated behavioural test, 1 pass/6 expects) plus onDisconnected wiring in tui-shell.ts/shell.ts prove: no provider switch, no turn interruption, one line naming the provider, and the saved key removed from process.env for this process.

AC8.note: keryx providers test <name> [--json] and keryx providers remove <name> [--yes] mirror the row buttons; remove refuses without confirmation on a terminal unless --yes; providers.disconnect.test.ts covers both CLI paths; providers list remains network-free (unchanged read path).

AC9.note: docs/docs/cli-reference.md 'remove' row and docs/docs/onboarding.md state plainly: disconnect removes only keryx's LOCAL credential copy; OAuth grant deleted from auth.json with no vendor revoke call; an API key stays valid at the vendor until revoked there. providers test/remove documented; onboarding + /help describe buttons and keys.

AC10.note: connect-provider-buttons.test.ts describe('AC10 — button/row colours come from the active theme') exercises two themes; colours come from themeColorToHex/resolveTheme. All new UI/CLI text reviewed as English.

AC11.note: src/standard/help-groups.ts HELP_GROUPS includes 'providers'; src/cli.ts USAGE_BODY lists providers test/remove; src/cli-reference-coverage.test.ts and src/standard/help-groups.test.ts pass (32 pass / 0 fail combined) confirming coverage.
